weekly.summary: Work projects hit a 92% completion rate — your most focused category this week. Your after-work self-development routine is settling in, and you're on a 5-day streak! Wednesday's completion rate dipped noticeably, though.
weekly.tip1: Your completion rate tends to drop on Wednesdays. Try trimming Wednesdays down to 3–4 to-dos and your rate should climb.
weekly.tip2: 9 AM and 7 PM after work are your most active hours. Try scheduling important to-dos in those slots.
weekly.tip3: Health & fitness sits at 71%, lower than your other categories. Blocking workout time on your calendar in advance makes it easier to stay consistent.
weekly.tip4: You're on a 5-day streak! Keep it going through the weekend to earn the 7-day streak badge.

monthly.summary: You finished February at an 82% completion rate — up 8 points from last month (74%)! Work projects led the way at 91%, and the self-development routine you set early in the month is turning into a habit. Your rate dipped slightly in week three but bounced back in week four, which is impressive.
monthly.tip1: Breaking monthly goals into weekly chunks makes them lighter. Try splitting this month's self-development goal into 8 per week.
monthly.tip2: Wednesday is your lowest day every week at 74%. A midweek refresh routine — a walk or a short meditation — can help you recharge.
monthly.tip3: Side projects came in at 67%, a bit short. Reserving a 2-hour block on weekend mornings will help you make steady progress.
monthly.tip4: You logged a 9-day streak! How about going for 14 days next month?
